name: Guāngmíng Jiànglín zhī Dì
source:
Does God play dice with the universe? I work on the most important problems of physics, one by one. The key is in the smallest details. Courage is taking responsibility for your own life. Maybe the universe has a purpose.

[From [url=https://serryatep.itch.io/]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
上帝与宇宙玩骰子吗？我一一研究最重要的物理学问题。关键在于最小的细节。勇气就是对自己的人生负责。也许宇宙是有目的的。

[来自[url=https://serryatep.itch.io/]Itch.io[/url]]
